text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A fan letter arrives for Mejiro Palmer, so I hand it to her in my office.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. Getting fan mail makes all the hard work I put into my races worth it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No time like the present to read this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A giddy Mejiro Palmer takes the envelope, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No way! She actually wrote me a letter?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It turns out a friend she met at an unofficial race was the one who penned the letter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: She said she'd send me a letter a while back, but didn't think she really would…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I wonder what she wrote? I bet she's just ribbing me, but let's see…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hm… "I saw you tear it up at the Twinkle Series, girl! Nice running!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "You were like a totally different person on the turf, unlike the nonstop yapper I know. You're way cooler when you're not talking! ☆" See? Takin' shots.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "You're always going on about your explosive breakaway and whatnot, but like…"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "The girl I saw out there was bold and wasn't afraid of facing a good challenge. Keep bringin' her back, 'kay?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ugh, don't compliment me for real… Now this feels like an actual fan letter from the heart…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Welp, let's start training! Throw in a few extra laps for me today, will ya?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I've gotta get her to come watch another one of my races so I can show her an even better runaway slay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From then on, Mejiro Palmer puts in a noticeably higher amount of effort during our training sessions.
